title: Luciano Pavarotti's birth chart
metaDescription: Luciano Pavarotti's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 18.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, the Sun holds a sextile to Mars at 0.1° — close enough to weld identity to drive. A sextile pays out only on effort; the scheme calls it opportunity rather than gift.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 18.2° of Libra is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Saturn in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Venus at 9.5° Virgo, Mars at 18.1° Sagittarius. Venus in an earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a fire sign reads as effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Saturn and Uranus hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 0.0° wide. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, the Sun sextile Mars at 0.1°, and Mars square Neptune at 2.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Uranus while both square Pluto. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags two placements in this chart. The Sun in Libra at 18.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 9.5° is in fall. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 3 earth, 3 water, 2 fire, 1 air; by modality, 4 mutable, 3 cardinal, 2 fixed. Mercury crossed from Scorpio into Libra during that day, so its sign is left open. Mercury, Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 15.1° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 21.9°.
